identity.name: Defy Skyline

case.bezel: faceted steel bezel integrated into the bracelet

identity.one_liner: An integrated-bracelet steel sports watch built on a non-chronograph automatic caliber from the El Primero family.

provenance_events.description: Zenith's Defy Skyline replaces the Defy Classic line in 2021 — a 41mm integrated bracelet sports watch with the high-frequency El Primero 3620 and a "starry sky" pattern on the dial.

narrative.story: The Defy Skyline, launched in 2022, uses a non-chronograph automatic caliber drawn from the El Primero family, running at the same 36,000-vibrations-per-hour high-beat frequency as Zenith's chronograph movements, which makes the small seconds hand visibly sweep faster than on a standard 28,800 vph watch. It joined the wave of integrated steel-bracelet sports watches that followed the Royal Oak and Nautilus template, competing at the more accessible end of that category.
narrative.collector_notes: Bracelet sizing and clasp adjustment mechanisms vary across early production batches; try the bracelet on before buying used, since sizing is not a simple add-or-remove-link system on every version.
